name: ffmpeg
title: FFmpeg
description: FFmpeg and FFprobe in the browser (openclaw/ffmpeg-wasm, built for the web by tools/ffmpeg-wasm), run like a command line in a pool of module workers: files in (Blobs mounted, never copied), the files a run wrote out, with progress and cancelling. Probes media, grabs filmstrip frames and decodes waveform peaks, with a React provider and hooks that share the work per file. Installs ffmpeg-worker.js into public/ffmpeg/; serve the wasm build next to it, from a cross-origin isolated page.
